 Jessica Moore USA TODAY Nov. 11, 2026, 11:23 a.m. ET Hear this story Pop star Pink has announced her first-ever Las Vegas residency at The Sphere.
 She will be the first solo woman artist to perform at the new venue.
 The nine-date residency is scheduled to run from Sept. 29 through Oct. 30 of next year.
 Tickets are currently on sale, with the cheapest seats starting at over $550.
 Get ready to throw some "Glitter in the Air," Pink is heading to Las Vegas for a history-making residency ! The three-time Grammy Award-winning singer has announced her first-ever residency at The Sphere next year, making her the first solo woman artist to perform at the venue.
 The nine-date residency will kick off Sept. 29 and run through Oct. 30 , giving fans plenty of chances to see the global popstar perform.
 Pink teased the residency in an Instagram video showing her on top of The Sphere surrounded by pink bubbles.
 "Bubbles!!!!!!!" Pink wrote on Instagram. "Makes me feel like I’m on top of the world. This idea has been bubbling up for years. And I finally get to share it with all of you! Let’s celebrate!"
 With The Sphere's immersive visuals and audio and Pink's popular hits like "So What," "Just Give Me a Reason," "Raise Your Glass," and so many more, this will be a must-see show you don't want to miss.
